title: Which certifications should an identity verification provider hold in the EU? | Trust Infrastructure Explained
summary: What an EU identity verification provider should prove at 3 levels (organisation, methods, legal status) and how to check each before you sign.
body_markdown:
An identity verification provider in the EU should show evidence at 3 levels: the organisation (ISO/IEC 27001, applicable DORA and NIS2 obligations), the methods it delivers (ETSI TS 119 461 for remote identity proofing, ISO/IEC 30107-3 for liveness, OpenID4VP conformance for wallets) and its legal status (a trust service register entry, where applicable). Authologic, a registered non-qualified trust service provider, orchestrates methods to which each of these applies differently.


*Written by Helena Suska (Head of Customer Success) and Florentyna Frend (Head of Product), Authologic.*
